content: प्रकाम {%a.%} .²1 Amorous. .²2 Excessive, much, to the heartʼs content, at pleasure; प्रकामविस्तार <ls>R. 2. 11</ls>; प्रकामालोकनीयताम् <ls>Ku. 2. 24</ls>. .{@-मः@} Desire, pleasure, satisfaction. .{@-मम्@} {%ind.%} .²1 Very much, exceedingly; जातो ममायं विशदः प्रकामम् (अन्तरात्मा) <ls>Ś. 4. 22</ls>; <ls>R. 6. 44</ls>; <ls>Mk. 5. 25</ls>. .²2 Sufficiently, to the heartʼs content, according to wish or desire. .²3 Voluntarily, willingly; ये तिष्ठन्ति भवन्तु तेऽपि गमने कामं प्रकामोद्यमाः <ls>Mu. 1. 25</ls>. .{@-भुज्@} {%a.%} eating till satisfied or to the heartʼs content; न प्रकामभुजः श्राद्धे स्वधासंग्रहतत्पराः <ls>R. 1. 66</ls>.
